title: LLMs Reproduce Stereotypes of Sexual and Gender Minorities

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing LLM responses on survey-style prompts (rating, selection, elicitation) using the Stereotype Content Model (SCM) to human baseline data, and analyzing word associations in creative text generation via semantic similarity mapping to Warmth/Competence axes and odds ratios.
